hooks.command: npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json > /tmp/tsc-check.txt 2>&1; ERRS=$(grep -c 'error TS' /tmp/tsc-check.txt); if [ "$ERRS" -gt 31 ]; then echo TS errors: $ERRS above baseline 31; tail -20 /tmp/tsc-check.txt; echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Nouvelles erreurs TypeScript au-dessus de la baseline 31. Corrigez-les ou regenerez src/integrations/supabase/types.ts avant de committer."}'; else echo tsc $ERRS errors baseline 31 report-only; echo '{"decision":"allow"}'; fi

npx vite build --mode production > /tmp/vite-build.txt 2>&1; if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then tail -30 /tmp/vite-build.txt; echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Vite production build failed. Fix build errors before committing."}'; else echo '{"decision":"allow"}'; fi
